record.paper_title: Some open problems on best approximation in normed linear spaces
record.context_brief: Finite-dimensional n > 3 case of convexity of Chebyshev sets
record.original_question: For each finite dimension n > 3, characterize the n-dimensional Banach spaces E for which every Chebyshev set in E is convex.

evidence.quote: BRONDSTED [3] has also solved the above characterization problem for n = 3 ... For n > 3 , the problem is still open.

artifact.self_contained_problem: Let $E$ be a real normed linear space with norm $\|\cdot\|$. A subset $M \subseteq E$ is called a Chebyshev set if, for every $x \in E$, there exists a unique point $m(x) \in M$ such that $\|x - m(x)\| = \inf_{y \in M}\|x - y\|$. For each fixed integer $n > 3$, give an intrinsic geometric characterization of those $n$-dimensional real Banach spaces $E$ (i.e., of the equivalence classes of norms on $\mathbb{R}^n$) with the property that every Chebyshev set in $E$ is convex.
artifact.status_search_result: A web search did not turn up a published characterization for general finite dimensions n > 3 of the n-dimensional Banach spaces in which every Chebyshev set is convex. The cases n = 2 and n = 3 are known (Brøndsted), and various partial/related results exist (e.g., A. L. Brown on suns, results on bounded Chebyshev sets), but no source clearly settles the full characterization in dimensions greater than 3.

status_evidence.title: Convex sets and Chebyshev sets, II (A. Brøndsted)
status_evidence.snippet: Brøndsted characterized finite-dimensional normed spaces of dimension ≤ 3 in which every Chebyshev set is convex.
status_evidence.claim: The characterization is known for n ≤ 3.

status_evidence.title: Bounded Chebyshev sets in finite-dimensional Banach spaces
status_evidence.snippet: Discusses Chebyshev sets in finite-dimensional Banach spaces and the role of boundedness and convexity.
status_evidence.claim: Related partial results exist but do not provide a full characterization for n > 3.

status_evidence.title: A look at proximinal and Chebyshev sets
status_evidence.snippet: Survey of convexity properties of Chebyshev sets, noting open questions in finite-dimensional non-Hilbert spaces.
status_evidence.claim: The general finite-dimensional characterization remains an open problem in the survey literature.
